source.surface: full-page unexpected-error state offering retry and a human escalation
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid black fill with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Try again, an outlined control of equal height with no fill, placed to its left
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: plain white page, no tinted banner, no card, no coloured rule
decisionColour.verdict: The filled control is the ESCALATION, not the retry. The product weights the human path above the mechanical one on a failure it describes as unexpected, which is the inverse of the PayPal and Threads pattern where retry carries the fill.
